verdict_rationale: Implementation is complete and the configuration is sound: Nix expression parses (nix-instantiate --parse exit 0), lockfile is generated with pinned revs (devenv update exit 0), flake inputs are evaluated (devenv info exit 0), `devenv build` succeeds, commit is landed with exactly the four in-scope files, and no drift into `.codegraph/`, `.omo/run-continuation/`, or other unrelated scopes. The `blocked` verdict comes from one acceptance criterion that cannot run in THIS container: `devenv shell -- true` exits non-zero because the Nix daemon in this environment restricts the `system` setting and the user 'mei' is not in /etc/nix/trusted-users. This is a container-environment limitation, not a config defect — on any host where the user has Nix trust-user status (or `trusted-users` includes the runner), `devenv shell -- true` will resolve cleanly. All other verification steps pass.
